evals.name: open-note-taken-up
evals.prompt: Write a note: Alice finished the schema migration today, and the search index now runs on PostgreSQL.
evals.expected_output: The open note gains a dated paragraph before its ## Next section, and its ## Next is brought up to date; no new note.
assertions: The session starts with a line naming notes/2026-10-08-search-index-postgresql.md as an open note, and the agent adds a dated paragraph to that note rather than writing a new one
No new file is written under notes/
The note keeps one ## Next heading, and it is its last section
The ## Next section no longer gives the schema migration as to do
review: The added paragraph reads as a record a teammate would keep

evals.name: no-open-note
evals.prompt: Write a note: we decided to drop the nightly export, since nobody reads it.
evals.expected_output: A new note under notes/, in draft, closing with a ## Next section.
assertions: No line at the session's start names an open note, so the agent writes a new note under notes/ named YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md
The note opens with a frontmatter holding status: draft
The note closes with a ## Next section
